mentions.name: MSP Trees
mentions.description: MSP Trees is a web tool for the Minneapolis/Saint Paul metro area where residents can look up trees near them: identify which species is shading them on a walk and check what the city's records say about the condition of their boulevard tree. It is built from public city data, normalized across different municipalities' GIS systems, with plans to extend the approach to more areas as data becomes available.
mentions.problem: Community doesn't end at city boundaries, but municipal GIS data systems do; the project works to normalize public tree information across different municipalities in the metro.
mentions.audience: People in the Minneapolis / Saint Paul metro area who care about trees.
mentions.source_excerpt:
If you’re in the Minneapolis / Saint Paul metro area and care about trees, you might like my recent project: https://msptrees.com

On a walk and wonder what species is shading you? Curious if the city thinks your boulevard tree is as sickly as you think it is? Find your spot on MSP Trees.
